summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 24, 2026, announcing FDA clearance of its IND for forazapadin in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy and a partnership with the FSHD Canada Foundation for up to US$5 million in non-dilutive financing. A Phase 2 study in FSHD is expected to begin in Q4 2026. No securities, ownership, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are involved; this is a routine clinical/regulatory and funding update, not a special situation.
